## Evidence

**The config works** (verified against `versions.toml`):
- `smolvm_golden_version` regex manager matches `smolvm_golden_version = "1.8.2"` → dep `smol-machines/smolvm`, `github-releases`, semver. Same for `runner_version` → `actions/runner`.

**Renovate has never created anything in `preloopdev/preloop`**:

- No "Dependency Dashboard" issue exists (it's created on the first run that finds updates).
- No self-hosted Renovate anywhere: no workflow in `.github/workflows/`, no local binary/cron/launchd/docker container.

**Repo is org-owned**: `preloopdev` org created 2026-06-26; the Renovate config landed 2026-08-11 (commits `c5b80084`/`f4d7d940`) — after the org move.

## Diagnosis

The **Renovate GitHub App is not installed on the `preloopdev` org** — the account that owns the repo. The `renovate.json`, `smolvm-release-verify.yml`, and `runner-sync.yml` tripwire wiring are all inert without it. If the app were installed (or ever ran), we'd see at minimum the Dependency Dashboard issue; there's no trace of any run. [Direct install status isn't queryable with the current token — the 401/403 from the installation endpoints is a token limitation, so this is inferred from the total absence of bot activity.]

## Fix (org admin, your action)

1. Go to `github.com/apps/renovate` → **Install** → select the `preloopdev` org → grant repo access to `preloop` (write needed for bump branches/PRs + dashboard issue).
2. Because `renovate.json` already exists, it skips onboarding and starts on its hourly schedule — expect the smolvm bump PR (1.8.2 → 1.13.1) and a Dependency Dashboard issue within the hour, plus the `actions/runner` tripwire PR when upstream moves past 2.336.0.

Since the pin (`1.8.2`, 2026-08-15) smolvm shipped **12 releases** (v1.8.3 → v1.13.1, all stable). Grouped by theme, with the release each landed in:

## Networking
- **Named inter-VM networks** with routed addressing between machines (1.8.3)
- `host.smolvm.internal` resolves to the gateway; default `/etc/hosts` when the image ships none (1.8.3)
- Loopback proxy host rewritten to the host's outbound address so guests can reach it (1.12.0)
- Guest IPv6 gated on real host reachability, resolver defaulted **IPv4-first** (1.10.1)
- libkrunfw guest kernel with **IPv4/IPv6 policy routing** — TUN-based VPN/proxy clients work (1.10.1)
- Guest TCP FIN forwarded properly in the virtio-net relay (1.8.3)

## Remote volumes / S3
- `--volume` can mount **S3 and any rclone remote** (1.10.0/1.10.1); agent mounts S3 natively, no rclone needed in the image (1.10.1)
- Remote volumes carried on every exec, on the embedded machine spec (SDK machines), and on ephemeral runs without a persistent overlay (1.11.0/1.11.1)

## Packing / image fidelity
- Default `/etc/hosts` provided (1.8.3); **auto-shrink disk by reclaiming freed blocks to the host** (1.9.0)
- Disk auto-grows an existing storage/overlay to the requested size instead of booting the stale one (1.9.2) — relevant to preloop's storage sizing
- Archive-flatten scratch staged on the storage disk instead of guest tmpfs; damaged layer caches rebuilt from the source artifact (1.9.1/1.9.2)
- Pack-export reads get one consistent ceiling (1.8.3 — yours); pre-1.13 packs extracted host-side when they predate in-guest unpacking (1.13.0)

## Forking / checkpoints
- Forkable golden survives config-change VM restarts; keep-alive container reused for fork-clone exec instead of a fresh container per call (1.9.1)
- **Transactional embedded batch forking**, hardened forked workloads (1.12.0); **nested machine checkpoints** (1.13.0); **portable live checkpoints** and fork checkpoints preserved across runtime restarts (1.13.1)

## GPU / display
- Segmented CUDA graph capture (1.9.0); automatic CUDA replay + distributed multi-GPU (1.9.2)
- Bundled Venus Vulkan driver injected into GPU workload containers; driver pinned only when the container has the bundle; mounted into pod/overlay containers too (1.9.0/1.12.0)
- **Opt-in virtio-gpu scanout + VNC** with virtio-input — interactive Linux desktop; VNC port now serves a browser client (1.12.0/1.13.1)

## Reliability / platform
- Broken blob downloads resume with bound retry instead of hanging machine create (1.10.1)
- Release lookup **fails instead of falling back to hardcoded 0.1.1** (1.13.0); expired registry-token warning instead of bare 401 (1.13.1)
- macOS: `libkrun.dylib` Homebrew refs relocated to `@loader_path` so packed launchers boot (1.9.2); missing hypervisor entitlement named on boot -22 (1.9.0 — yours); net-enabled libkrun restored (1.8.0); aarch64-KVM snapshot + fork support (1.9.2)
- Windows krun.dll rebuilt so machines boot on WHP again (1.10.1)
- Egress policy enforced even when served from the image cache; egress denials recorded per machine (1.9.0/1.8.1)
- cgroup2 controllers delegated at agent boot; unknown fields rejected on exec/run API (1.9.0/1.9.2); h2 bumped to clear RUSTSEC-2026-0258 (1.9.0)

## Worth flagging for preloop
- **1.9.2's `@loader_path` relocation** — `preloop update --ensure-runtime` on macOS installs "latest stable ≥ 1.8.1"; packed-launcher boot was broken before 1.9.2, so the floor's minimum is fine but the runtime floor comment ("first release satisfying all invariants") predates it.
- 1.13.0's fail-fast release lookup is a behavior preloop's `--ensure-runtime` interacts with (no silent 0.1.1 fallback).
- Your own PRs shipped in this window: pack-export read ceiling (1.8.3), macOS entitlement message (1.9.0), flatten EAGAIN window + post-`--` option validation + storage disk grow (1.9.2), mount-socket collision fix (1.8.0).

The renovate bump would go 1.8.2 → **1.13.1**; the smolvm-release-verify E2E gate exists precisely because the disk-grow and egress changes touch preloop's VM lifecycle.

content.text:
The exact root cause was a **schema validation error in `renovate.json`** that caused Renovate to abort every run on this repo before extracting any dependencies or opening PRs.

### Why it failed

Running `renovate-config-validator` and the Renovate engine locally on `renovate.json` caught the exact error:

```text
INFO: Found renovate config errors
  - topic: "Configuration Error"
  - message: "Custom Manager contains disallowed fields: extractVersion"
INFO: Repository has invalid config
  - validationError: "The renovate configuration file contains some invalid settings"
```

1. **`extractVersion` vs `extractVersionTemplate`**: Renovate's regex manager schema requires `extractVersionTemplate`, not `extractVersion`.
2. **`regexManagers` vs `customManagers`**: Renovate migrated `regexManagers` to `customManagers` with `customType: "regex"`.

Because `extractVersion` was rejected as a disallowed field, the Renovate worker failed configuration validation and silently exited without opening any PRs or creating the Dependency Dashboard.

---

### The Fix

`renovate.json` has been updated and validated cleanly (`INFO: Config validated successfully`):

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json",
  "extends": ["config:recommended"],
  "dependencyDashboard": true,
  "packageRules": [
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["actions/runner", "smol-machines/smolvm"],
      "labels": ["dependencies"]
    },
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["smol-machines/smolvm"],
      "description": "SmolVM bumps auto-merge once ci.yml and the smolvm-release-verify check pass.",
      "automerge": true,
      "automergeType": "pr"
    },
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["actions/runner"],
      "description": "Runner bump PR is the tripwire for the runner-watch pipeline.",
      "labels": ["protocol-sync", "dependencies"]
    }
  ],
  "customManagers": [
    {
      "customType": "regex",
      "description": "Official actions/runner release pin in versions.toml.",
      "fileMatch": ["^versions\\.toml$"],
      "matchStrings": ["runner_version\\s*=\\s*\"(?<currentValue>[^\"]+)\""],
      "depNameTemplate": "actions/runner",
      "datasourceTemplate": "github-releases",
      "versioningTemplate": "semver",
      "extractVersionTemplate": "^v(?<version>.*)$"
    },
    {
      "customType": "regex",
      "description": "SmolVM release the golden workflow builds with.",
      "fileMatch": ["^versions\\.toml$"],
      "matchStrings": ["smolvm_golden_version\\s*=\\s*\"(?<currentValue>[^\"]+)\""],
      "depNameTemplate": "smol-machines/smolvm",
      "datasourceTemplate": "github-releases",
      "versioningTemplate": "semver",
      "extractVersionTemplate": "^v(?<version>.*)$"
    }
  ]
}
```

Once merged to `main`, Renovate's next worker pass will pass validation, generate the **Dependency Dashboard** issue, and open the bump PR for **`smolvm_golden_version` (`1.8.2` $\rightarrow$ `1.13.1`)**.

**Yes, exactly.** Renovate acts as the **tripwire** that kicks off the entire official runner synchronization pipeline.

---

### The End-to-End Trigger Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[New official actions/runner release on GitHub] -->|GitHub Releases datasource| B[Renovate opens PR bumping runner_version in versions.toml]
    B -->|renovate.json applies protocol-sync label & blocks automerge| C[.github/workflows/runner-sync.yml triggered on PR]
    C --> D[prep job: ubuntu-latest]
    D -->|runner-watch diff| E[Calculates source delta from baseline]
    E -->|runner-watch triage| F[Generates protocol specs in .runner-watch/specs/]
    F -->|gh pr comment| G[Posts spec & delta summary directly on Renovate PR]
    D --> H[sync job: runner-sync host]
    H -->|mitmproxy + official runner| I[Captures new protocol wire goldens]
    I -->|runner-watch conform| J[Runs conformance test suite against Preloop]
    J --> K[Opens tiered implementation PRs for protocol deltas]
```

### 1. The Renovate Tripwire (`renovate.json`)
- **Datasource**: Watches `actions/runner` on `github-releases`.
- **Target**: Bumps `runner_version = "..."` in `versions.toml`.
- **Rules**:
  - Sets label: `["protocol-sync", "dependencies"]`.
  - Blocks auto-merge (`automerge: false`) because upstream runner changes require wire golden verification and spec review before adopting.

### 2. The Sync Workflow (`.github/workflows/runner-sync.yml`)
Triggered automatically whenever a PR modifies `versions.toml` (or manually via `workflow_dispatch` with custom `--from` / `--to` tags):

1. **`prep` job** (Runs on `ubuntu-latest`):
   - Compares the upstream runner codebase (`runner-watch diff --from <old> --to <new>`).
   - Parses code changes into protocol specs (`runner-watch triage`).
   - Comments the change summary directly onto Renovate's tripwire PR.
2. **`sync` job** (Runs on `runner-sync` host with `mitmproxy`):
   - Records wire goldens with the real binary.
   - Verifies Preloop's broker and Results Service conformance.
   - Spawns tiered draft PRs on `runner-sync/v<version>` branches for any protocol deltas.

### 1. How the Agent Implementation Works (`runner-watch`)
The agent pipeline is built directly into `crates/runner-watch`:
- **Implementer (`runner-watch implement`)**: Uses `codex exec <prompt>` (configurable via `agents.implement`) to implement each generated protocol spec in `.runner-watch/specs/<version>/`.
  - Runs in a loop up to `max_implement_iterations` (default: 10).
  - Automatically runs `cargo check` and relevant tests after each iteration. If compile/tests fail, it feeds the compiler/test error back into the agent prompt to retry.
  - Automatically commits passing implementations per spec.
- **Reviewer (`runner-watch review`)**: Uses `claude` (configurable via `agents.review`) to review implementation diffs against upstream protocol semantics.

---

### 2. Current Configuration Status in the Repo

| Component | Status | Location / Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Deterministic Triage (`prep` job)** | ✅ **Enabled** | Runs on `ubuntu-latest` (no agents needed); comments spec summary on Renovate PR |
| **Agent Implementation Code** | ✅ **Implemented** | `crates/runner-watch/src/main.rs` (`implement` + `review` commands) |
| **Self-Hosted Runner Host** | ⏸️ **Not Configured** | Needs a self-hosted runner labeled `[self-hosted, runner-sync]` with `mitmproxy` + official runner |
| **`RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE`** | ❌ **Not Set** | Repo variable required for the `sync` job to run |
| **`RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS`** | ❌ **Not Set** | Repo variable (`RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS=true`) required to run `implement` and `review` steps |

---

### 3. What happens right now when a runner release drops:
1. Renovate opens the `runner_version` bump PR (`protocol-sync`).
2. The `prep` job runs on `ubuntu-latest`, parses the upstream C# runner delta, creates the protocol specs, and posts a comment on the PR.
3. Because `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE` and `RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS` are not set, the workflow produces the spec breakdown for human review and draft PRs rather than dispatching autonomous agents.

To turn on autonomous agent implementations:
1. Register a runner labeled `[self-hosted, runner-sync]` with `codex`, `claude`, and `mitmproxy` installed.
2. Set repository variables:
   - `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE=/path/to/workspace`
   - `RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS=true`

**Yes, exactly.** The workflow is designed specifically for Preloop's execution model and will run cleanly without queue stalls:

### 1. How Preloop handles `runner-sync.yml`
* **`prep` job (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`)**:
  * Runs on Preloop's standard Linux microVM runner pool (or GitHub-hosted).
  * Executes the deterministic diff (`runner-watch diff`) and triage (`runner-watch triage --no-agents`).
  * Posts the spec summary comment to Renovate's tripwire PR and attaches the `.runner-watch/specs/**` artifacts.
* **`sync` job (`runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]`)**:
  * Gated with a root-level condition: `if: vars.RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''`.
  * Because Preloop evaluates job-level `if` expressions at workflow submission time, when `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE` is unset, Preloop **skips `sync` immediately** rather than letting it sit queued indefinitely waiting for a labeled runner.

### 2. Summary of our workflow states in self-hosted CI

| Workflow | Trigger / Runner | Behavior in Preloop |
|---|---|---|
| **`ci.yml`** | PRs / Main (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`) | Standard test & lint suite across microVM pool |
| **`smolvm-release-verify.yml`** | Renovate smolvm bumps (`runs-on: [self-hosted, smolvm-host]`) | Active (gated by `SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE=/opt/actions-runner`) |
| **`runner-sync.yml` (`prep`)** | Renovate runner bumps (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`) | Runs automatically, diffs upstream, and posts specs on the PR |
| **`runner-sync.yml` (`sync`)** | Needs-gated downstream (`runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]`) | Cleanly skipped until a dedicated MITM capture runner is provisioned |

content.text: how long does it take for renovate to open the pr?

For the hosted GitHub App (Mend Renovate):

### 1. Typical Timeline
* **Scheduled pass**: If waiting passively, Renovate scans repositories on its queue roughly **every 1 to 2 hours** (usually within 30–60 minutes).
* **On push/merge to `main`**: When a commit lands on the default branch (e.g. merging the `renovate.json` fix), GitHub delivers a `push` webhook to Renovate. Renovate prioritizes default-branch pushes and typically queues the scan **within 1 to 5 minutes**.

---

### 2. What you'll see first
1. **Dependency Dashboard Issue**: Renovate first opens or updates an issue titled `Dependency Dashboard` listing all detected packages (`actions/runner`, `smol-machines/smolvm`, cargo crates, etc.).
2. **The Bump PRs**: Immediately alongside the dashboard, it opens the PRs (e.g. `smolvm_golden_version: 1.8.2 -> 1.13.1`).

---

### 3. Forcing / Speeding it up
Once the **Dependency Dashboard** issue is opened, Renovate includes a checkbox:
> `[ ] Check this box to trigger a Renovate run immediately`

Checking that box triggers a worker pass on demand without waiting for the next cron cycle.

Here is the draft PR for the Renovate configuration fix:

---

### **Title**:
`fix(ci): migrate renovate regexManagers to customManagers with valid schema`

### **Base Branch**:
`main` $\leftarrow$ `fix/renovate-custom-managers`

### **Body**:
```markdown
## Summary
Fixes Renovate execution by migrating deprecated `regexManagers` to `customManagers` and updating the invalid `extractVersion` field to `extractVersionTemplate`.

## Root Cause
When Renovate scanned the repository, it failed configuration schema validation with:
`Custom Manager contains disallowed fields: extractVersion`
causing the engine to abort execution before extracting dependencies, generating the Dependency Dashboard, or opening bump PRs.

## Changes
- Replaced `regexManagers` with `customManagers` using `customType: "regex"`.
- Replaced `extractVersion` with `extractVersionTemplate` (`^v(?<version>.*)$`).
- Validated cleanly with `renovate-config-validator` (`INFO: Config validated successfully`).
```

# CI & Workflow Architecture, Operational Constraints, and Design Rationale

This document serves as the internal technical reference for Preloop's GitHub Actions workflows (`.github/workflows/*.yml`). It records the rationale, hardware/virtualization constraints, failure modes, memory ceilings, and protocol tripwires embedded in our automation design.

---

## 1. Execution Model & Pool Resource Limits

### Dogfooding & Runner Environment
* **Executor**: Preloop's own runner and microVM control plane serve as the self-hosted execution environment for CI (`runs-on: self-hosted`).
* **Root Execution in Guest**: The runner operates as `root` within disposable Linux guest VMs. Direct `apt-get` calls are used rather than `sudo` because the base golden image's `/etc/sudoers` can cause `sudo` audit plugin permission checks to fail.
* **Linker & Memory Ceilings**:
  * In `ci.yml`, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"` and `RUST_TEST_THREADS: "2"` are strictly enforced.
  * Measured linking memory: 2 parallel debug `rustc` + GNU `ld` links peak at **~4.6 GiB** in the guest.
  * The guest microVM memory ceiling is **5 GiB**. Unbounded compilation parallelism exhausts memory and causes the host to OOM-kill or the guest kernel to SIGKILL `rustc`.
  * `LLD` (`-C link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld`) is installed and used to keep link memory overhead bounded and link times fast.
* **Test Runner Performance (libtest vs nextest)**:
  * `cargo test` (libtest) is used instead of `cargo-nextest`. Benchmarks on our microVM pool showed `nextest`'s per-test process spawn model introduced **~4 minutes of overhead** across 1,600+ fast unit tests (total execution ~17.5m on nextest vs 13.4m on libtest).

### Security & Context Isolation
* **Fork PR Policy**: Fork PRs are untrusted code and must **never** execute on the self-hosted microVM pool or access privileged secrets (`RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_TOKEN`, cloud credentials). Fork PRs run only hosted jobs or supply-chain checks. Same-repo PRs, main pushes, and scheduled jobs run on self-hosted runners.
* **LFS Pointer Invariants**: Conformance goldens in `.runner-watch/golden/**` are tracked via Git LFS. Workflows must pull LFS objects explicitly (`lfs: true` and `git lfs pull`); otherwise, fixtures arrive as text pointer stubs, causing silent test failures or deserialization errors.

---

## 2. Testing & Conformance Strategy

### Property-Based Testing Profiles (`ci.yml`)
* **Fast Profile (PRs / Pushes)**:
  * 256 test cases for pure state-machine, scheduler, expressions, and runner dispatcher properties.
  * 64 test cases for heavier HTTP sequence properties (`concurrency_http_properties`).
  * Enforces `PROPTEST_CASES` bounds to keep pull request CI times within acceptable limits.
* **Intensive Profile (Nightly Schedule / Manual Dispatch)**:
  * Runs in `--release` mode with `PROPTEST_CASES=10000` and `PROPTEST_MAX_SHRINK_ITERS=100000`.
  * Designed to discover subtle, deep race conditions in state machines and scheduling queues.
* **CI Safety Guards**:
  * **Zero-Filter Guard**: Before running test suites with test name filters, workflows execute `cargo test -- --list | grep <filter>` and assert a non-zero match count. This prevents property tests from silently passing if a test or filter is renamed.
  * **Sleep Guard**: Property test files are mechanically scanned for `sleep(`. Asynchronous properties must use deterministic polling, virtual clocks, or synchronization primitives rather than wall-clock delays.
  * **Differential Harness Dry-Run**: Replays concurrency cases algebraically without requiring live GitHub or external credentials, asserting schema validity and rejecting intentionally contaminated fixtures.

### Live Conformance & Oracles (`tier2-property-live.yml`, `conformance.yml`, `runner-conformance.yml`)
* **Official Runner as Oracle**: In `tier2-property-live.yml`, the official GitHub-hosted runner executes live workflow commands (heredoc environment variables, heredoc outputs, `::stop-commands::`, `::add-mask::`).
* **Mask Sentinel Validation**: Sentinels are emitted to verify that the runner worker properly redacts secrets from logs and correctly propagates environment changes across step boundaries.
* **Light vs Deep Conformance**:
  * **Light**: Runs on every PR/push; replays captured wire flows through `benchmarks/conformance/run.sh` and verifies status codes, schema shapes, and Twirp results service payloads.
  * **Deep**: Boots the built runner inside real macOS/ARM64 and Linux microVMs against full scenario batches (`101-*` to `115-*`). Gated by `RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_HOST_WORKSPACE` to avoid queuing when a dedicated host is not provisioned.

---

## 3. Renovate & Upstream Synchronization Pipelines

### Renovate Tripwire Architecture (`renovate.json`)
* **Upstream Triggers**: Renovate monitors `actions/runner` and `smol-machines/smolvm` on GitHub Releases.
* **`runner_version`**: Bumps to `runner_version` in `versions.toml` are labeled `protocol-sync` and configured with `automerge: false`. This PR acts as the tripwire for protocol reconciliation.
* **`smolvm_golden_version`**: Bumps are labeled `dependencies` with `automerge: true`, but are strictly gated on `ci.yml` and `smolvm-release-verify.yml`.

### Runner Protocol Sync Pipeline (`runner-sync.yml`)
* **`prep` Job (`ubuntu-latest`)**:
  * Automatically diffs the upstream `actions/runner` C# repository between release tags (`runner-watch diff`).
  * Runs deterministic triage (`runner-watch triage --no-agents`) to extract changed endpoints, timeline contracts, and feature flags into TOML specs in `.runner-watch/specs/<version>/`.
  * Posts the triaged spec summary and delta breakdown directly as a comment on Renovate's tripwire PR.
* **`sync` Job (`runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]`)**:
  * **Gating Design**: Uses a root-level condition `if: vars.RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''`. Because Preloop evaluates job `if`s at workflow submission time, an unset variable causes Preloop to immediately skip the job rather than leaving it stalled in the queue.
  * **Autonomous Agent Stages**: When `RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS == 'true'`, runs `runner-watch implement` (Codex) to generate Rust implementations for each spec, verifying each iteration with `cargo check` and tests. It then invokes `runner-watch review` (Claude) to inspect the diffs.
  * **Golden Capture**: Uses `mitmproxy` and the official runner binary to capture raw protocol byte flows against real GitHub.
  * **Tiered PR Generation**: Branches from `runner-sync/v<version>` and opens tiered draft PRs grouped by protocol criticality.

### SmolVM Release Verification (`smolvm-release-verify.yml`)
* **Verification Scope**: Gates any update to `smolvm_golden_version` by testing the upgrade path on a real virtualization host before golden images are baked.
* **Capability & Boot Probes**:
  * Probes CLI capability flags (e.g. `--mount-socket`).
  * Boots a microVM from the pinned Ubuntu base image and executes commands over the guest channel.
* **Packed Ownership Invariant**:
  * Tests that packing and rehydrating an Alpine machine with non-root ownership (`2345:2345`) preserves archived UID/GID metadata. (This prevents regressions of the ownership leakage bug fixed in SmolVM 1.8.1).
* **Host Serialization**: Uses `concurrency: group: smolvm-host` because installing candidate binaries mutates `~/.smolvm` on the host.

---

## 4. Release Engineering & Golden MicroVM Baking (`release-golden.yml`, `release-linux-runner.yml`)

### Golden Image Baking Constraints
* **Template Inode Exhaustion**:
  * Stock SmolVM ext4 disk templates ship with only 32,768 inodes (intended for small single-binary containers).
  * The GitHub-hosted runner image contains >200,000 files across 18 layers. Extracting layers on stock templates caused `ENOSPC` during the .NET SDK layer extraction.
  * `release-golden.yml` formats fresh 120 GiB sparse ext4 templates with **7.8 million inodes** directly on the host prior to layer extraction.
* **Alpine Guest Init / Resize2fs Workarounds**:
  * Alpine's default guest init `PATH` (`/bin:/usr/bin`) omits `/usr/sbin`. During `mount_storage_disk`, `Command::new("resize2fs")` failed with `NotFound`, leaving `/storage` at its initial 512 MiB size.
  * Workaround: `e2fsprogs` binaries (`resize2fs`, `tune2fs`) are symlinked using **absolute targets** into `/bin`. (Relative links like `../usr/sbin/resize2fs` fail on Alpine because `/bin` and `/usr/bin` are merged, resolving incorrectly to `/usr/usr/sbin/resize2fs`).
* **HTTP/2 Stream Desync & Registry Pulls**:
  * SmolVM's Go agent uses an HTTP/2 transport that experienced flow-control window throttling and `PROTOCOL_ERROR` stream resets on multi-gigabyte layers.
  * Golden builds pull the base image via the host Docker daemon (which downloads in parallel with chunked resume and local caching), then export to a local tarball.
* **Host RAM Allocation & Retry Gating**:
  * Golden image bakes extract ~60 GB of toolsets and require a 120 GB guest disk.
  * SmolVM allocates machine data directories keyed by name hash; stale directories from failed runs can reuse previous disk sizes. Golden bakes generate unique run-specific machine names (`preloop-golden-<timestamp>`) to ensure fresh storage allocations.
  * The golden build host is shared with the CI runner pool. The bake VM requires 4 GiB of committable RAM. Builds probe host memory headroom before launching to prevent `EAGAIN` failures.

### Artifact Sizing & Supply Chain Attestations
* **GitHub Release Asset Limits (2 GiB Limit)**:
  * Full golden microVM images are **10–15 GiB** and exceed GitHub's 2 GiB release asset upload limit.
  * Release workflows upload provenance sidecars, checksums, and Cosign signature bundles to the GitHub Release.
  * The raw golden archive is retained as a workflow artifact and chunked into `<4 GiB` parts using `split -b 4000M` to bypass `actions/upload-artifact`'s 10 GiB single-file ceiling.
* **SLSA Provenance & Keyless Signing**:
  * Keyless signing is performed with Cosign using GitHub Actions OIDC tokens (Fulcio + Rekor).
  * Build provenance is attested via GitHub's attestation service (`actions/attest-build-provenance`), cryptographically binding the base OCI image digest, workspace commit SHA, and output golden hash.

### Cross-Compilation Strategy (`release-linux-runner.yml`)
* **Zig-Powered Toolchains**:
  * `cargo-dist` builds macOS binaries natively on macOS runners, but cannot cross-build Linux guest runner binaries (`x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` and `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`).
  * `release-linux-runner.yml` uses `cargo-zigbuild` with Zig 0.14.1 to produce glibc-compatible runner bundles for Linux guests from an `ubuntu-22.04` builder.
* **Toolchain Pinning**:
  * Rust toolchains are pinned explicitly to `1.97` rather than floating `stable` to prevent `E0463` cross-compilation errors (`can't find crate for core`) on self-hosted workers.

---

## 5. Summary Matrix of Workflow Triggers & Targets

| Workflow | Triggers | Runner Target | Primary Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ci.yml` | Push (`main`), PR, Nightly (02:00 UTC) | `self-hosted` (Preloop microVMs) | Workspace compilation, clippy, unit tests, fast/intensive proptests |
| `conformance.yml` | Push (`main`), PR, Daily (03:45 UTC) | `self-hosted` | Wire-protocol replay against recorded official goldens |
| `runner-conformance.yml` | PR (light), Weekly (03:00 UTC, deep) | `self-hosted` / `smolvm-host` | Protocol fidelity checks for `preloop-runner` vs official runner |
| `runner-sync.yml` | PRs touching `versions.toml`, Dispatch | `ubuntu-latest` (prep) / `runner-sync` (sync) | Upstream `actions/runner` diffing, spec triage, golden captures, tiered PRs |
| `smolvm-release-verify.yml` | Renovate `smolvm_golden_version` PRs | `[self-hosted, smolvm-host]` | Live VM boot, socket probing, and ownership preservation testing |
| `tier2-property-live.yml` | Push to worker/protocol files | `self-hosted` (official runner oracle) | Live workflow commands, heredocs, output masking, and oracle checks |
| `release-golden.yml` | Release publish, Manual dispatch | `[self-hosted, Linux, X64]`, macOS ARM64 | 120 GB Ubuntu 24.04 golden microVM bake, Cosign signing, SLSA attestation |
| `release-linux-runner.yml` | Release publish, Manual dispatch | `ubuntu-22.04` (cargo-zigbuild) | Cross-compiles Linux `preloop-runner` bundles for guest distribution |
| `release.yml` | Tag push | Hosted matrix (cargo-dist) | Native CLI binaries, installer scripts, and GitHub Release drafting |
| `pullfrog.yml` | Issue comments, PRs, Dispatch | `self-hosted` | AI PR review and automation agent |
| `push-route-probe.yml` | Push / Control-plane dispatch | `self-hosted` | End-to-end test of direct (non-webhook) control-plane submission |
| `zizmor.yml` | Push (`main`), PR | `self-hosted` | Static analysis for GitHub Actions security best practices |

name: ci
permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile:
        description: "Property profile: fast (default) or intensive"
        required: false
        default: "fast"

jobs:
  rust:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      PROPTEST_CASES: "8"
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: "2"
      RUSTFLAGS: "-C link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - name: Materialize conformance goldens
        run: |
          git lfs pull --include=".runner-watch/golden/**"
          fixture=".runner-watch/golden/v2.335.1/06-multi-step/flows.jsonl"
          test -s "$fixture"
          if grep -q '^version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/' "$fixture"; then
            echo "LFS fixture was not materialized: $fixture" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c
        with:
          toolchain: "1.97"
          components: rustfmt,clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@49a0bdc70d2e1b713ca9e2869b211fcce03d3c1c

      - name: Install lld linker
        run: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends lld

      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: |
          cargo clippy --locked -p preloop-gha-protocol -p preloop-gha-parser -p preloop-gha-expressions -p preloop-cache -p preloop-artifacts -p runner-watch -p preloop-conformance --all-targets -- -D warnings
          cargo clippy --locked -p preloop-runner -p preloop-runner-server -p preloop-runner-client -p preloop-dap --all-targets
      - run: cargo test --locked --workspace
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: "-A warnings -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld"

  property-tests-fast:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c
        with:
          toolchain: "1.97"

      - name: Verify concurrency_properties filter matches at least one test
        run: |
          count=$(PROPTEST_CASES=1 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'concurrency_properties' || true)
          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: filter 'concurrency_properties' matched zero tests in preloop-runner-server" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "concurrency_properties: $count test(s) found"

      - name: Verify property filters match tests
        run: |
          server=$(PROPTEST_CASES=1 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec 'concurrency::properties|concurrency_properties|concurrency_http_properties' || true)
          runner=$(cargo test -p preloop-runner -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'timespan_tests' || true)
          parser=$(cargo test -p preloop-gha-parser -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'concurrency_' || true)
          if [ "$server" -eq 0 ] || [ "$runner" -eq 0 ] || [ "$parser" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: zero matching tests (server=$server runner=$runner parser=$parser)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Check no sleep() in property test files
        run: |
          files="crates/preloop-runner-server/src/concurrency_properties.rs crates/preloop-runner-server/src/concurrency_http_properties.rs"
          bad=0
          for f in $files; do
            if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q 'sleep(' "$f"; then
              echo "ERROR: sleep() found in $f" >&2

            fi
          done
          if [ "$bad" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
          echo "Sleep guard: OK"

      - name: Pure concurrency properties
        run: |
          PROPTEST_CASES=256 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server \
            'concurrency::properties' -- --test-threads=1
          PROPTEST_CASES=256 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server \
            concurrency_properties::pure -- --test-threads=1

      - name: Scheduler model properties
        run: |
          PROPTEST_CASES=256 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server \
            concurrency_properties::state_machine -- --test-threads=1

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c
        with:

      - name: Verify concurrency_properties filter matches at least one test

          if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then

            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify property filters match tests
        run: |
          server=$(PROPTEST_CASES=1 cargo test -p preloop-runner-server -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec 'concurrency::properties|concurrency_properties|concurrency_http_properties' || true)
          runner=$(cargo test -p preloop-runner -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'timespan_tests' || true)
          parser=$(cargo test -p preloop-gha-parser -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'concurrency_' || true)
          if [ "$server" -eq 0 ] || [ "$runner" -eq 0 ] || [ "$parser" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: zero matching tests (server=$server runner=$runner parser=$parser)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Check no sleep() in property test files
        run: |
          bad=0
          for f in \
            crates/preloop-runner-server/src/concurrency_properties.rs \
            crates/preloop-runner-server/src/concurrency_http_properties.rs; do
            if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q 'sleep(' "$f"; then
              echo "ERROR: sleep() found in $f" >&2
              bad=1
            fi
          done
          if [ "$bad" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi

      - name: Intensive property profile (release)
        run: |
          PROPTEST_CASES=10000 PROPTEST_MAX_SHRINK_ITERS=100000 \
            cargo test -p preloop-runner-server 'concurrency::properties' \
            --release -- --test-threads=1
          PROPTEST_CASES=10000 PROPTEST_MAX_SHRINK_ITERS=100000 \

      - name: Intensive HTTP sequence profile (release)

      - name: Differential harness dry-run

name: runner-conformance
permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  runner-light:
    name: Runner light conformance
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - name: Validate runner status responses
        run: python3 benchmarks/real-world/runner-conformance.py --mode light
      - name: Upload light report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: runner-light-conformance
          path: benchmarks/compatibility/runner/behavior/RUNNER-CONFORMANCE-REPORT.md
          if-no-files-found: error

  runner-deep:
    name: Runner deep conformance
    if: (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && vars.RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, smolvm-host]
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      GH_REPO: ${{ vars.RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_REPO || 'preloopdev/preloop-conformance' }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_TOKEN }}
      HOST_WORKSPACE: ${{ vars.RUNNER_CONFORMANCE_HOST_WORKSPACE || '' }}
      PRELOOP_RUNNER_HOST: ${{ github.workspace }}/target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/preloop-runner
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - name: Build current PR runner for smolVM
        run: cargo zigbuild -p preloop-runner --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
      - name: Run deep runner conformance
        run: |
          rm -f benchmarks/compatibility/runner/behavior/conformance-{preloop,official}.jsonl
          bash ./benchmarks/real-world/batch-conformance.sh both '10[1-9]-*' '11[0-5]-*'
          python3 benchmarks/real-world/runner-conformance.py --mode deep
      - name: Upload deep report and captures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: runner-deep-conformance
          path: |
            benchmarks/compatibility/runner/behavior/RUNNER-CONFORMANCE-REPORT.md
            benchmarks/compatibility/runner/behavior/conformance-*.jsonl
            benchmarks/compatibility/runner/behavior/vm-*.log
          if-no-files-found: error

jobs:

name: runner-sync

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - versions.toml
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      from:
        description: "Baseline runner tag to diff from (default: last reconciled)"
        required: false
        type: string
      to:
        description: "Target runner tag to reconcile (default: runner_version in versions.toml)"
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  prep:
    name: Prep runner sync (diff + triage)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      moved: ${{ steps.moved.outputs.moved }}
      from: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.from }}
      to: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@52699249a776424c51ebc9ee197baf0f9dbf0d8a
      - name: Resolve versions
        id: versions
        env:
          INPUT_FROM: ${{ github.event.inputs.from }}
          INPUT_TO: ${{ github.event.inputs.to }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT="$(python3 scripts/resolve-runner-versions.py \
            --from "$INPUT_FROM" \
            --to "$INPUT_TO")"
          FROM="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^from=//p')"
          TO="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^to=//p')"
          echo "from=$FROM" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "to=$TO" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Detect runner_version movement
        id: moved
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MOVED=true
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            if git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
                || ! git diff "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
                     | grep -q '^[+-]runner_version'; then
              MOVED=false
            fi
          fi
          echo "moved=$MOVED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Init runner-watch config
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        run: |
          cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- init || true
      - name: Diff upstream tags
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          VER_FROM: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.from }}
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- diff --from "$VER_FROM" --to "$VER_TO"
      - name: Triage delta into specs
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- triage --no-agents
      - name: Summarize on the tripwire PR
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          VER_FROM: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.from }}
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SPECS="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open(".runner-watch/triage-summary.json")).get("specs", 0))')"
          BODY="runner-sync: $VER_FROM -> $VER_TO triaged into **$SPECS specs** (deterministic, no agents). See [the run]($SERVER_URL/$REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID) for delta.json and the spec set. The sync job then records goldens, conforms, and opens the tiered PRs once a runner-sync host is provisioned."
          gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER" --body "$BODY"
      - name: Upload triage artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: runner-sync-prep
          path: |
            .runner-watch/delta.json
            .runner-watch/triage-summary.json
            .runner-watch/specs/**
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  sync:
    name: Runner sync (record-golden + conform + tiered PRs)
    needs: prep
    if: vars.RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''
    runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      HOST_WORKSPACE: ${{ vars.RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@52699249a776424c51ebc9ee197baf0f9dbf0d8a
      - name: Detect runner_version movement
        id: moved
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MOVED=true
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            if git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
                || ! git diff "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
                     | grep -q '^[+-]runner_version'; then
              MOVED=false
            fi
          fi
          echo "moved=$MOVED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Resolve versions
        id: versions
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          INPUT_FROM: ${{ github.event.inputs.from }}
          INPUT_TO: ${{ github.event.inputs.to }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUT="$(python3 scripts/resolve-runner-versions.py \
            --from "$INPUT_FROM" \
            --to "$INPUT_TO")"
          FROM="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^from=//p')"
          TO="$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^to=//p')"
          echo "from=$FROM" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "to=$TO" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Init runner-watch config
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- init || true
      - name: Diff upstream tags
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          VER_FROM: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.from }}
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- diff --from "$VER_FROM" --to "$VER_TO"
      - name: Triage delta into specs
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- triage --no-agents
      - name: Implement specs (agents)
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true' && vars.RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS == 'true'
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- implement
      - name: Review implementations (agents)
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true' && vars.RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS == 'true'
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- review
      - name: Record official goldens
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
        run: cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- record-golden --runner "$VER_TO" --non-interactive
      - name: Replay against the built server
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 benchmarks/conformance/check_corpus.py || true
          cargo build --quiet -p preloop-runner-server
          STATE_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/runner-sync.XXXXXX")"
          SERVER_LOG="$STATE_DIR/server.log"
          REPLAY_PORT="$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')"
          REPLAY_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$REPLAY_PORT"
          SERVER_PID=""
          cleanup() { [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ] && kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          PRELOOP_PUBLIC_URL="$REPLAY_URL" \
            PRELOOP_CONFIG="$STATE_DIR/config.toml" \
            PRELOOP_REGISTRATION_POLICY="permissive" \
            ./target/debug/preloop-server serve --listen "127.0.0.1:$REPLAY_PORT" \
            --state-dir "$STATE_DIR/server-state" >"$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          for _ in $(seq 1 600); do
            kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat "$SERVER_LOG" >&2; echo "replay server exited" >&2; exit 1; }
            curl -fsS "$REPLAY_URL/healthz" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
            sleep .1
          done
          curl -fsS "$REPLAY_URL/healthz" >/dev/null || { cat "$SERVER_LOG" >&2; echo "replay server not ready" >&2; exit 1; }
          cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- conform --runner "v$VER_TO" \
            --preloop-url "$REPLAY_URL" --skip-cargo-test
          kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          wait "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          SERVER_PID=""
          trap - EXIT
          echo "conform: PASS"
      - name: Open tiered sync PRs
        if: steps.moved.outputs.moved == 'true'
        env:
          VER_TO: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.to }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh auth setup-git
          git config user.name "preloop-sync[bot]"
          git config user.email "preloop-sync[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          BRANCH="runner-sync/v$VER_TO"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- pr --dry-run
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(runner-sync): reconcile actions/runner v$VER_TO"
            git push origin "$BRANCH"
          fi
          cargo run -q -p runner-watch -- pr --base main --head "$BRANCH"
      - name: Upload conformance report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: runner-sync-conformance
          path: |
            .runner-watch/conformance/**
            .runner-watch/conformance-report.md
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: smolvm-release-verify

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - versions.toml
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "SmolVM release to verify (default: smolvm_golden_version in versions.toml)"
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: smolvm-host
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify smolvm release on smolvm-host
    if: (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'renovate/')) && vars.SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''
    runs-on: [self-hosted, smolvm-host]
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Detect golden-pin movement
        id: changed
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CHANGED=false
          if ! git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
              && git diff "$BASE_SHA" -- versions.toml \
                 | grep -q '^[+-]smolvm_golden_version'; then
            CHANGED=true
          fi
          echo "changed=$CHANGED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Resolve candidate version
        id: resolve
        env:
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$INPUT_VERSION" ]; then
            VERSION="$INPUT_VERSION"
          else
            VERSION="$(grep '^smolvm_golden_version' versions.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)"
          fi
          [ -n "$VERSION" ] || { echo "no smolvm version resolved" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Install candidate smolvm (mirrors release-golden.yml)
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || steps.changed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          SMOLVM_VERSION: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$(uname -s)/$(uname -m)" in
            Darwin/arm64) PLATFORM="darwin-arm64"; DATA_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/smolvm" ;;
            Darwin/x86_64) PLATFORM="darwin-x86_64"; DATA_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/smolvm" ;;
            Linux/x86_64) PLATFORM="linux-x86_64"; DATA_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/smolvm" ;;
            Linux/aarch64) PLATFORM="linux-arm64"; DATA_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/smolvm" ;;
            *) echo "unsupported host $(uname -s)/$(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          ARCHIVE="smolvm-${SMOLVM_VERSION}-${PLATFORM}.tar.gz"
          BASE="https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/releases/download/v${SMOLVM_VERSION}"
          WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/smolvm-verify.XXXXXX")"
          curl -fsSL -o "$WORK/$ARCHIVE" "$BASE/$ARCHIVE"
          curl -fsSL -o "$WORK/checksums.sha256" "$BASE/checksums.sha256"
          ( cd "$WORK" && grep -F "$ARCHIVE" checksums.sha256 | shasum -a 256 -c - )
          tar -xzf "$WORK/$ARCHIVE" -C "$WORK"
          SRC="$WORK/smolvm-${SMOLVM_VERSION}-${PLATFORM}"
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.smolvm"
          rm -rf "$HOME/.smolvm/lib"
          cp -R "$SRC/lib" "$HOME/.smolvm/lib"
          rm -f "$HOME/.smolvm/storage-template.ext4" \
              "$HOME/.smolvm/overlay-template.ext4" \
              "$HOME/.smolvm/storage-template.ext4.zst" \
              "$HOME/.smolvm/overlay-template.ext4.zst"
          for f in smolvm smolvm-bin storage-template.ext4 overlay-template.ext4 \
              storage-template.ext4.zst overlay-template.ext4.zst; do
            [ -f "$SRC/$f" ] && cp "$SRC/$f" "$HOME/.smolvm/"
          done
          echo "$SMOLVM_VERSION" > "$HOME/.smolvm/.version"
          mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"
          rm -rf "$DATA_DIR/agent-rootfs"
          cp -R "$SRC/agent-rootfs" "$DATA_DIR/agent-rootfs"
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
          ln -sfn "$HOME/.smolvm/smolvm" "$HOME/.local/bin/smolvm"
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Probe capabilities
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || steps.changed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          smolvm --version
          smolvm machine create --help | grep -q -- --mount-socket \
            || { echo "candidate lacks --mount-socket" >&2; exit 1; }

      - name: Boot a VM with the candidate (regression smoke)
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || steps.changed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NAME="preloop-verify-$(date +%s)"
          SOCKET="$(mktemp -u "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/preloop-verify.XXXXXX.sock")"
          cleanup() {
            smolvm machine stop --name "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine delete --name "$NAME" -f >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            rm -f "$SOCKET"
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT
          IMAGE="$(grep '^ubuntu_24_04_base' versions.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)"
          [ -n "$IMAGE" ] || { echo "ubuntu_24_04_base missing from versions.toml" >&2; exit 1; }
          python3 -c "import socket; s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); s.bind('$SOCKET'); s.close()"
          echo "creating machine from $IMAGE"
          smolvm machine create --name "$NAME" \
            --image "$IMAGE" \
            --net \
            --mount-socket "$SOCKET:/run/preloop-verify.sock"
          smolvm machine start --name "$NAME"
          echo "waiting for the guest to boot..."
          BOOTED=""
          for _ in $(seq 1 150); do
            if smolvm machine exec --name "$NAME" -- sh -c 'echo smolvm-verify-ok' \
                | grep -q smolvm-verify-ok; then
              BOOTED=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          if [ -z "$BOOTED" ]; then
            echo "machine did not boot (or exec failed) with candidate smolvm" >&2
            smolvm machine status --name "$NAME" 2>&1 || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "candidate smolvm boots VMs: PASS"

      - name: Verify packed ownership preservation
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || steps.changed.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_NAME="preloop-ownership-base-$(date +%s)"
          CLONE_NAME="${BASE_NAME}-clone"
          WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/preloop-ownership.XXXXXX")"
          PACK="$WORK/ownership-pack"
          echo "SMOLVM_VERIFY_BASE_NAME=$BASE_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SMOLVM_VERIFY_CLONE_NAME=$CLONE_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SMOLVM_VERIFY_WORK=$WORK" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          cleanup() {
            smolvm machine stop --name "$CLONE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine delete --name "$CLONE_NAME" -f --cascade >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine stop --name "$BASE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine delete --name "$BASE_NAME" -f --cascade >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            rm -rf "$WORK"
          }
          trap cleanup EXIT

          smolvm machine create --name "$BASE_NAME" \
            --image alpine:3.20 \
            --net \
            --init 'addgroup -g 2345 repro && adduser -D -u 2345 -G repro repro && touch /opt/preloop-ownership && chown 2345:2345 /opt/preloop-ownership'
          smolvm machine start --name "$BASE_NAME"
          READY=""
          for _ in $(seq 1 150); do
            if smolvm machine exec --name "$BASE_NAME" -- \
                sh -c 'test "$(stat -c %u:%g /opt/preloop-ownership)" = 2345:2345'; then
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          [ -n "$READY" ] || { echo "ownership fixture VM did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; }
          smolvm machine stop --name "$BASE_NAME"
          smolvm pack create --from-vm "$BASE_NAME" --output "$PACK" --no-sign
          smolvm machine create --name "$CLONE_NAME" --from "${PACK}.smolmachine"
          smolvm machine start --name "$CLONE_NAME"
          ACTUAL=""
          for _ in $(seq 1 150); do
            ACTUAL="$(smolvm machine exec --name "$CLONE_NAME" -- \
              sh -c 'stat -c %u:%g /opt/preloop-ownership' 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 || true)"
            if [ "$ACTUAL" = "2345:2345" ]; then
              break
            fi
            if [ -n "$ACTUAL" ]; then
              echo "packed ownership mismatch: expected 2345:2345, got $ACTUAL" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          [ "$ACTUAL" = "2345:2345" ] \
            || { echo "packed ownership mismatch: expected 2345:2345, got $ACTUAL" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "packed ownership preservation: PASS"

      - name: Cleanup ownership regression machines
        if: always()
        run: |
          set +e
          if [ -n "${SMOLVM_VERIFY_CLONE_NAME:-}" ]; then
            smolvm machine stop --name "$SMOLVM_VERIFY_CLONE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine delete --name "$SMOLVM_VERIFY_CLONE_NAME" -f --cascade >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          fi
          if [ -n "${SMOLVM_VERIFY_BASE_NAME:-}" ]; then
            smolvm machine stop --name "$SMOLVM_VERIFY_BASE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            smolvm machine delete --name "$SMOLVM_VERIFY_BASE_NAME" -f --cascade >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          fi
          if [ -n "${SMOLVM_VERIFY_WORK:-}" ]; then
            rm -rf "$SMOLVM_VERIFY_WORK"
          fi

name: tier2-property-live

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/actions/tier2-property-oracle/**
      - .github/workflows/tier2-property-live.yml
      - crates/preloop-gha-protocol/Cargo.toml
      - crates/preloop-gha-protocol/src/azdo.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/Cargo.toml
      - crates/preloop-runner-server/Cargo.toml
      - crates/preloop-gha-parser/src/dag.rs
      - crates/preloop-gha-parser/src/lib.rs
      - crates/preloop-gha-parser/src/matrix_expand.rs
      - crates/preloop-gha-expressions/src/lib.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/commands.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/contexts.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/file_commands.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/job_extension.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/official_oracles.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/step_conditions.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/step_records.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner/src/worker/steps_runner.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner-server/src/lib.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner-server/src/scheduling.rs
      - crates/preloop-runner-server/proptest-regressions/**
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  tier2-property-live:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@52699249a776424c51ebc9ee197baf0f9dbf0d8a

      - name: Run targeted Tier 2 Rust property filters
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          run_filter() {
            local package="$1"
            local filter="$2"
            local output
            echo "=== cargo test -p ${package} ${filter} --lib ==="
            if ! output="$(cargo test -p "$package" "$filter" --lib -- --nocapture 2>&1)"; then
              printf '%s\n' "$output"
              return 1
            fi
            printf '%s\n' "$output"
            if [[ "$output" == *"running 0 tests"* ]]; then
              echo "filter matched zero tests: ${package} ${filter}" >&2
              return 1
            fi
          }

          run_filter preloop-gha-protocol tier2_codec_
          run_filter preloop-runner worker::commands::tests
          run_filter preloop-runner worker::contexts::tests::masking_
          run_filter preloop-runner worker::file_commands::tests
          run_filter preloop-runner lifecycle
          run_filter preloop-runner-server workflow_steps_update_

      - name: Run remote JavaScript oracle (declaration 1)
        id: oracle_first
        uses: preloopdev/preloop/.github/actions/tier2-property-oracle@88e5328dd1ee742206bc5e4f12823613744aa311
        with:
          id: first

      - name: Run remote JavaScript oracle (declaration 2)
        id: oracle_second
        uses: preloopdev/preloop/.github/actions/tier2-property-oracle@88e5328dd1ee742206bc5e4f12823613744aa311
        with:
          id: second

      - name: Exercise workflow command files and controls
        id: command_contracts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          run_id="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-1}"
          run_attempt="${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"
          env_delimiter="TIER2_ENV_${run_id}_${run_attempt}"
          output_delimiter="TIER2_OUTPUT_${run_id}_${run_attempt}"
          path_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/tier2-property-path-${run_id}-${run_attempt}"
          mkdir -p "$path_dir"
          cat > "$path_dir/tier2-path-probe" <<'SCRIPT'
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          printf '%s\n' path-propagated
          SCRIPT
          chmod +x "$path_dir/tier2-path-probe"

          {
            printf 'TIER2_HEREDOC_ENV<<%s\n' "$env_delimiter"
            printf 'line-one\nline-two:%s\n' "$run_attempt"
            printf '%s\n' "$env_delimiter"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          {
            printf 'heredoc<<%s\n' "$output_delimiter"
            printf 'output-line-one\noutput-line-two\n'
            printf '%s\n' "$output_delimiter"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          printf '%s\n' "$path_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

          stop_token="tier2-stop-${run_id}-${run_attempt}"
          printf '::stop-commands::%s\n' "$stop_token"
          printf '::error::this-error-must-be-suppressed-while-stopped\n'
          printf '::%s::\n' "$stop_token"
          printf '::notice::stop-commands-resumed\n'

          sha="${GITHUB_SHA:-000000000000}"
          sha_short="${sha:0:12}"
          mask_sentinel="tier2-mask-${run_id}-${run_attempt}-${sha_short}"
          printf '::add-mask::%s\n' "$mask_sentinel"
          printf 'tier2-mask-sentinel-after=%s\n' "$mask_sentinel"

      - name: Verify caller-visible command propagation
        shell: bash
        env:
          FIRST_RESULT: ${{ steps.oracle_first.outputs.result }}
          SECOND_RESULT: ${{ steps.oracle_second.outputs.result }}
          OUTPUT_HEREDOC: ${{ steps.command_contracts.outputs.heredoc }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$FIRST_RESULT" == "tier2-oracle-first-main-state-ok" ]]
          [[ "$SECOND_RESULT" == "tier2-oracle-second-main-state-ok" ]]
          run_attempt="${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"
          expected_env=$'line-one\nline-two:'"$run_attempt"
          [[ "$TIER2_HEREDOC_ENV" == "$expected_env" ]]
          expected_output=$'output-line-one\noutput-line-two'
          [[ "$OUTPUT_HEREDOC" == "$expected_output" ]]
          [[ "$(tier2-path-probe)" == "path-propagated" ]]
          echo "GITHUB_ENV, GITHUB_OUTPUT heredocs, and GITHUB_PATH propagated to caller"

        include:
          - triple: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      contents: write

        uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c
        with:
          toolchain: "1.97"
          targets: ${{ matrix.triple }}

      - name: Set up Zig cross toolchain

          path: |
            dist/preloop-runner-${{ matrix.triple }}

          if-no-files-found: error
